concerns.text: Task T104 claims to produce `data/results/analysis_results.json` that conforms to `results.schema.yaml`, but the schema requires the fields `robustness_delta_r_max` and `sensitivity_excluded`. T104’s description only mentions Pearson/Spearman/GAM results and does not generate these fields, violating FR-004 and the contract.

Task T101’s unified dataset CSV (`data/processed/unified_dataset.csv`) lacks several required columns from `dataset.schema.yaml` (e.g., `element`, `correlation_length`, `best_fit_model`, `low_freq_spectral_power`, `is_censored`). Consequently the artifact cannot validate against the dataset contract, weakening FR-001.

FR-001 specifies that samples missing EDS maps must be flagged as `incomplete`. The dataset schema and T101’s CSV have no column to capture this flag, so the requirement has no landing place, constituting a silent weakening of the functional requirement.

Task T105 runs LOO‑CV and sensitivity analysis, producing `loo_robustness.json` and `sensitivity_analysis.json`, but does not merge their outputs into `analysis_results.json`. The results schema expects `robustness_delta_r_max` and `sensitivity_excluded` in the main results file, so the contract is not satisfied.

Principle VII of the constitution requires statistical reports to include confidence intervals for Pearson/Spearman coefficients. Neither the results schema nor T107’s report generation mentions CI fields, so the modeling transparency requirement is violated.

The spec and data model define an `is_undefined` flag for correlation lengths that do not decay within image bounds, but T102’s `spatial_metrics.csv` only includes `is_censored`/`censored_value`. The undefined case is dropped, weakening FR-002/FR-003.

Data‑model.md defines per‑model correlation lengths (`correlation_length_exp`, `_gauss`, `_power`) and a `composite_metric`, yet T102’s CSV stores only a single `correlation_length` and omits the composite metric, diverging from the declared data model.

Principle VI mandates provenance metadata linking derived concentration maps to raw files and preprocessing script versions. No task specifies writing such side‑car metadata, breaching the spatial‑characterization consistency principle.

The plan’s computational ordering (step 6) mentions “partial correlation / multivariate analysis” to address chemical coupling, but no task implements this analysis, leaving a plan‑mandated requirement unfulfilled.
The results schema does not include confidence‑interval fields required by Principle VII, yet T104 is expected to satisfy that principle. This mismatch constitutes a contract violation.
